rules: Do not assign a GDC post number here. content/gdc-post-register.md is the only place a number is claimed.

queue.title: Decoding Digital Risk: Comparing Parent and Teen Reports of Teens' Online Activities.
queue.proposedTitle: How much do you really know about what your child does online? A new study suggests less than you think. I include myself.
queue.urgency: Medium. Published four days ago, so it is current, and nothing in it expires.

queue.title: Feasibility Study of Methods and Data to Understand the Impact of Smartphones and Social Media on Children and Young People
queue.proposedTitle: The government asked its own scientists whether social media harms children. Their answer was that nobody has run the experiment.
queue.urgency: Medium. The report is ten months old as a publication, so it is not news, but it is UK, official, and directly relevant to the argument about the under 16 restriction. It does not expire.

queue.title: Families’ attitudes towards age assurance: research commissioned by the ICO and Ofcom
queue.proposedTitle: The regulators asked families about age checks. They found that parents were often the ones helping children past them.
queue.urgency: Low to medium. The research is from 2022 and must be dated in the first lines. Its relevance comes from the restriction that is on its way, so it does not expire soon.
